steps.text: Soil can be too acidic or too basic for crops. Farmers fix it by neutralisation, bringing the pH toward 7.
Tap “Acidic Soil” to choose soil that has too much acid.
Now tap “Apply Neutralisation Treatment” to add a base to the soil.
Watch the pH climb toward 7 — into the neutral zone where crops grow best.
Balanced soil means healthy crops. Farmers add lime (a base) to acidic soil, or compost to basic soil — chemistry helping agriculture!

coach.mission: Balance the soil's pH for healthy crops.
whenStuck: Pick a soil, then tap “Apply Neutralisation Treatment”.
Acidic soil needs a base (lime); basic soil needs acid (compost).
whenWrong: Push the pH toward 7 — add a base to acidic soil, or acid to basic soil.
Crops grow best near neutral, so aim for pH 7.
whenCorrect: Balanced! Crops will thrive at pH 7.
coach.done: You've neutralised soil for farming. Try the other soil, or move on.
